message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported operating income of 458 million representing an increase of 86 percent on a year earlier as the filing attributes this improvement to strong performance across commercial communications and aerospace markets [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group posted operating income of 155 million reflecting a rise of 68 percent from the prior year while management noted growth across semiconductor, general electronics, automotive and energy markets in the release [D1]. Total segment operating income rose to 613 million representing an increase of 81 percent on a year earlier while the filing attributes this improvement to strong performance across both reportable segments [D1].
